summary: Data-DSL uses-mission steps waiting for child-run capacity wake reactively when a holder releases it, including across repeated serialized handoffs.

replay.detail: No historical claim rewrite or replay change. Waiting runs acquire their holder dependencies when evaluated.

schema.detail: No claim, API or SQLite schema changes.

rules.detail: No authorization, retention, checkpoint or registry changes. Existing mission population limits and idempotency checks are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire-format change or coordinated member upgrade requirement. Upgrade the member evaluating the waiting parent to obtain reactive capacity handoffs.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon restart is required; restart timing was not measured for this fix.

manual.detail: No mission republishing, manual release, run retry or state repair is required.

recovery.detail: Used-mission parents track capacity holders before attempting a child start and after a capacity refusal, sharing the program engine's dependency tracking. A newly admitted parent follows its child's outcome immediately, before any subsequent lookup. Holder transitions and subsequent holder handoffs re-evaluate waiting parents without a polling workaround or periodic full pass.
